text_block_list.text: Pathetic... But, I have to face the facts.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, the master of some
martial arts
dojo used to come by our
house and say...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
"There is mystery in victory, but no
mystery in
defeat."
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I think that's right. This defeat was
brought on
by my... lack of ability.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I think that's right. This defeat was
brought on
by my... lack of ability.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Stop. Don't try to comfort me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I explain that I don't want her to be too
hard on
herself because a poor mental
state can interfere
with training.

...Hah! So that's why? In that case,
you've got
nothing to worry about.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I'm not as soft as you might think.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and now I'm going to train harder
than
ever.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Our opponents won't wait for us...
They're going
to keep pushing forward
too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've got to get ahead of them. It'll be a
thorny
road, but I'm ready.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I just can't allow myself to forget the
bitter
taste of defeat.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
